name: pi-bg-handoff
description: Spots long-running Bash commands and moves them to background tasks, with host-side wait tools and the background-commands skill

scripts.fork:clone: git clone https://github.com/ismailsaleekh/pi-background-tasks fork/pi-background-tasks && git clone https://github.com/AledHe/pi-agent-wait fork/pi-agent-wait
scripts.fork:pull: git -C fork/pi-background-tasks pull --ff-only && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait pull --ff-only
scripts.fork:patch: git -C fork/pi-background-tasks checkout -- src/ && git -C fork/pi-background-tasks apply ../../patches/pi-background-tasks.patch && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait checkout -- src/ test-support/ test/ && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait apply ../../patches/pi-agent-wait.patch
scripts.fork:patch:check: git -C fork/pi-background-tasks checkout -- src/ && git -C fork/pi-background-tasks apply --check ../../patches/pi-background-tasks.patch && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait checkout -- src/ test-support/ test/ && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait apply --check ../../patches/pi-agent-wait.patch
scripts.fork:patch:generate: git -C fork/pi-background-tasks diff -- src/ > patches/pi-background-tasks.patch && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait diff -- src/ test-support/ test/ > patches/pi-agent-wait.patch
scripts.fork:pristine: git -C fork/pi-background-tasks checkout -- src/ && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait checkout -- src/ test-support/ test/
scripts.test:forks: npm --prefix fork/pi-background-tasks test && npm --prefix fork/pi-agent-wait test
